1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, __wherein the opening is formed by removing at least a portion of a solder mask layer and exposing an underlying core layer__; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure has an increased thickness and contact area relative to a thickness and contact area of the opening in the solder mask layer__.

2. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a bottom surface of the opening __and extends into the core layer__.

3. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening __and extends into the core layer__.

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __to increase contact area with a lid or ring structure__.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __and into an underlying core layer to increase the effective thickness of the stiffening microstructure__.

6. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer, __and the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the exposed core layer to increase structural rigidity__.

7. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes__ a lid.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, __wherein the increased thickness and contact area of the stiffening microstructure improves heat dissipation efficiency__.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring __having an increased thickness and contact area formed by the opening extending through the solder mask layer and into the core layer__.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in contact with the stiffening microstructure, __and the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the ground reference plane layer through the opening__.

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, __wherein the opening is formed by removing at least a portion of a solder mask layer and exposing an underlying core layer__; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure has an increased thickness and contact area relative to a thickness and contact area of the opening in the solder mask layer__.

15. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening, __and extends into the core layer__.

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __to increase contact area with a lid or ring structure__.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __and into an underlying core layer to increase the effective thickness of the stiffening microstructure__.

18. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer, __and the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the exposed core layer to increase structural rigidity__.

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is one of a ring or a lid, __wherein the ring or lid has an increased thickness and contact area formed by the opening extending through the solder mask layer and into the core layer__.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the ground reference plane layer, __and the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the ground reference plane layer through the opening__.
